messages:
Maya: Foxtail updated the RFP again — they want the one-page capability matrix, a clear burst billing formula, and an encryption diagram for Private deploy. Need everything in the Foxtail folder by EOD Wed.
Ethan: copy. I'll stand up a slim one-pager. Which perf numbers do we want to quote? conservative or optimistic?
Maya: conservative but real. Use sustained + conservative burst headroom. Example: Hosted: 50 QPS sustained @512 tokens (p95 220ms); Dedicated (4xA100 equiv): 300 QPS sustained, tolerant to 10x bursts for short windows; Private: provide ranges and note depends on customer infra.
Rina: Legal reminder: say "compatible with FIPS-validated HSMs" but don't claim FIPS certification. Also confirm BYOK and default KMS rotation (90 days). I'll drop SOC2 snapshot and BYOK wording in the folder.
Ethan: Draft billing snippet: burst_fee = base_rate * excess_multiplier * minutes_billed * billing_multiplier; where excess_multiplier = (burst_QPS/commit_QPS - 1) and billing_multiplier = 2.5. Numeric example: commit=300 QPS, burst=1500 QPS for 5m -> excess=4, minutes=5 -> burst_charge = base_rate * 4 * 5 * 2.5.
Maya: that formula works. OpsBot: any bench runs available?
OpsBot: bench-job foxtail-4932101234 started (ephemeral cluster). ETA 60m. Will post p50/p95/p99 and batching assumptions.
Rina: attaching encryption diagram once legal signs off, plus SOC2 excerpt. Note on quantization: we support 8-bit production, 4-bit experimental on some models — mark as caveat.
Ethan: I'll finish the one-pager and add the billing example + tiny footnote about autoscale smoothing (30s) and graceful throttling. Uploading to https://drive.redwood/foxtail/onepager_final.xlsx when done.
Maya: solid. Action items: Ethan finalize matrix; Rina attach certs and BYOK text; OpsBot post bench logs; I'll assemble and upload final packet by EOD Wed. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
